hook: You sleep under THIS every night.

steps.say: Check the care label and drum size.
Dry it fully so mould can't grow.

safety.say: One product only. Never mix cleaners.

safetyCheck: Checked 2026-11-06: liquid detergent only, one product at a time; no bleach, no vinegar+bleach, no ammonia, nothing mixed. Check care label and drum capacity before washing; dry fully (tumble low or air) so mould cannot grow inside; do not overload the drum or force a wet duvet into a small dryer.
